criteria.different_work_same_subject: They concern the same particular subject or requested instance but perform different immediate work, such as computing its unpaid amount versus creating its booking, or reading an object versus changing it. This does not establish causation or plan following.
criteria.partial_work_overlap: Some particular immediate work is shared, but at least one unit contains additional material work or targets. A subset, superset or intersecting scope is not whole-target identity. This differs from doing entirely different work on the same subject.
criteria.same_work_target: The entire immediate work scope matches: the same operation goal, particular referent(s), and requested task instance(s). A different tool, method, ordering, or parameter may implement the same complete work scope.
criteria.unrelated: No specific work-target or subject relationship is supported beyond a broad topic or overall task.
criteria.unresolved: The evidence leaves necessary identity or work scope unspecified, ambiguous or contradictory. A missing beneficiary, referent or requested instance must not be filled from similarity, proximity or the presence of only one candidate.

state.comparison_rule: Judge each current/prior pair independently; several prior actions may be related. Compare the complete immediate work and the particular referents/task instances. The concrete operation and target plus their source evidence control scope. A work_target summary may describe a broader objective and is not by itself evidence of identical work. If one action concerns A and B and the other only B, choose partial_work_overlap. Reading and changing the same object are different_work_same_subject, not partial overlap. criteria.different_instance: Similar or identical operations concern different people, artifacts, periods, or separately requested instances. They must remain different targets.
criteria.different_work_same_subject: They concern the same particular subject or requested instance but perform different immediate work, such as computing its unpaid amount versus creating its booking, or reading an object versus changing it. This does not establish causation or plan following.
criteria.partial_work_overlap: Some particular immediate work is shared, but at least one unit contains additional material work or targets. A subset, superset or intersecting scope is not whole-target identity. This differs from doing entirely different work on the same subject.
criteria.same_work_target: The entire immediate work scope matches: the same operation goal, particular referent(s), and requested task instance(s). A different tool, method, ordering, or parameter may implement the same complete work scope.
criteria.unrelated: No specific work-target or subject relationship is supported beyond a broad topic or overall task.
criteria.unresolved: The evidence leaves necessary identity or work scope unspecified, ambiguous or contradictory. A missing beneficiary, referent or requested instance must not be filled from similarity, proximity or the presence of only one candidate.

criteria.partial_work_overlap: Some particular immediate work is shared, but at least one unit contains additional material work or targets. A subset, superset or intersecting scope is not whole-target identity. This differs from doing entirely different work on the same subject.
criteria.same_work_target: The entire immediate work scope matches: the same operation goal, particular referent(s), and requested task instance(s). A different tool, method, ordering, or parameter may implement the same complete work scope.

criteria.unresolved: The evidence leaves necessary identity or work scope unspecified, ambiguous or contradictory. A missing beneficiary, referent or requested instance must not be filled from similarity, proximity or the presence of only one candidate.
